fact: We sell lead lists: named decision-makers at target companies, matched to your ideal customer profile and buying signals, delivered as a CSV with name, company and profile URL.
Standard price is £4 per lead for a lead list.
Invoices are due on 7-day terms, paid by card or bank transfer from the Stripe invoice.
No discounts for new clients. 10% over 200 leads exists only as a remembered deal for a specific client, never as a standing offer.
Leads are sourced after the order is confirmed and delivered as a CSV when the invoice is paid; you are billed only for leads actually delivered.
Prices are net of VAT; UK VAT at 20% is added on the invoice.
We do not run outreach campaigns, write copy, or sell email-sending infrastructure.
